snippet.title: Season 4 Intro Cinematic | Battlefield 6
snippet.description:
Pax Armata's relentless campaign for control of the Pacific has begun. As NATO's offshore military bases come under attack, the conflict expands across land, air, and sea in the next chapter of Battlefield 6.

Battle across massive amphibious battlefields, command new vehicles, wield new weapons, and adapt to the Dynamic Wave System as the war reaches the Pacific. Later in the season, the conflict continues with the arrival of the Top Gun update, featuring new fighter jets, new experiences, and more.

The war has reached new shores. Secure every front.

Battlefield 6 Season 4 is live now.

#Battlefield6
